oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0', and '# pass' equal to '# tests': the database cases ran, none skipped. Every named case in S2 is 'ok': a turn sent with session.id 'sess-1' and 'sess-2' lands in two different conversations, each turn keeps its anchorSeq (a fractional 12.5 survives) and a restore with ?session= reads that session only; a session id that is not a plain token falls back to the account-level conversation and a non-numeric anchorSeq is stored as null; the tip is recorded once per account and read back as tipSeen; the prompt carries the Discord link and no Talk-to-a-person handoff and tells the model to pass nothing on to the agent; the controller sends exactly one POST /api/assistant/turns at a time, refuses a fourth waiting question on screen, keeps a stopped answer, pauses on a 429 with the 'day' window, and every request it makes goes to /api/assistant/*. Ratings: an answer is rated by its own account only (another account's answer, a question, a cleared conversation read as 404; a value other than 1, -1 or null is 400) and the thumb is put back when the server refuses. Readers: only chosen columns reach the prompt (no turn title or reply, notification or comment text), an editor never sees teammates' emails, per-site readers do not run without a site on screen, and a failed read becomes a 'not available right now' line. A request to report a problem adds a report built from site, time, session id, browser and the person's own words, with no email or conversation. After a 429 (minute or day) the next question the person types is SENT, not left on Waiting; the start screen's Help dock follows the newest row. S3 passes with no failed file: an argued line '/x hello' for a takesText action is consumed whole and run receives 'hello' (no command.execute, no submit); the line guard clears the draft only while it equals the line; attachments refuse the line and keep the draft; caseInsensitive folds '/X Hello' to the lowercase command and keeps the text; a client-local row sits after every log row at or below its anchorSeq and above later agent rows, and with no local rows the transcript is identical to before. S4: no floating AI Assistant button or Need help? pill; the '/' menu lists 'Ask about Tracy and your sites'; '/help <q>' empties the composer, sends exactly one POST /api/assistant/turns with message '<q>' and the session id and anchorSeq, and the answer and the question are drawn (in the dock on a blank session, in the transcript afterwards); '/HELP' folds to '/help'; a bare '/help' draws one greeting with four chips and sends nothing; two quick questions are sent one after the other with 'Waiting' shown; a thumbs up posts rating 1 to the answer id; an ordinary message sends nothing to /api/assistant and reaches the agent; in 'modify, /help, modify' the agent receives exactly the two modify messages and nothing of /help, and the transcript order is modify, Help, modify; no horizontal overflow at 375px.
